# #2563: Patch: Back closes a card opened in the Collection or in the statistics, as it already closes one in the Almanac
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
On a phone, a player opens a card from a set in their Collection, then swipes back to close it. Instead of closing the card, the screen leaves the card list for the Collection's front page and folds the set again. The same swipe on the statistics page, with a card's breakdown open, leaves the statistics entirely. In the card library and the patch notes, Back already closes the card first. After this change it does on these two screens as well.

## Why
- R2127000 says Back closes the topmost sheet or dialog before it leaves the screen, and lists the dialogs that do. The Almanac's and the patch notes' card dialogs get this through `useBackLayer` (`apps/web/src/cards/inspect/store.ts:207`, `apps/web/src/patches/PatchNotes.tsx:339`).
- `apps/web/src/collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx:261-278` handles only Escape for its `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` view (`:310`).
- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx:424-466` handles only Escape and Tab for the card drill-down modal (`:1483-1492`).
- Neither dialog is in R2127000's "Which" list or its "Never by Back" list. So the gap is an omission, not a decision.

## Proposal
- `CardCosmeticsView` calls `useBackLayer(onClose)`.
- The /stats drill-down moves into a small child component that calls `useBackLayer(() => setCardDrillDownId(null))`. That way the layer exists only while the modal is open.
- R2127000's "Which" list names the Collection's card view and the statistics card breakdown, and its `proven_in` lists the two new tests. Their titles carry `R2127000`.

## Where it lands
`apps/web/src/collection/CardCosmeticsView.tsx` and `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`. Tests go in `collection/collection.test.tsx` and `routes/stats.test.tsx`, driven by `src/test/history.ts`. The ruling edit is in `spec/rulings/R2127000.md` (§10.10).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] With a Collection card open, one Back closes it and leaves `?section=cards` and the open set as they were.
- [ ] With a /stats card breakdown open, one Back closes it and the page stays on /stats with its tab and filters.
- [ ] With neither open, Back leaves the screen as it does today.
- [ ] Focus goes back to the card that opened each one, as it does when Escape closes them.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes with the amended R2127000.

## Size and risks
Small to medium. /stats writes its address with `navigate(target, { replace: true })` (`routes/stats.tsx:289`). The Almanac already combines replace-writes of `?card=` with a Back layer, so the same pattern works here. The test should cover a filter change made while the modal is open.
